name: Courage in Numbers [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your allies give you courage when you face an enemy as one.

Prerequisite(s): Iron Will.

Benefit(s): You grant a +2 morale bonus on saves against fear to every ally within 10 feet. This bonus stacks with other instances of this feat to a maximum of +8.
